title: Ep. 0001 — Extreme Ownership (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: The leader owns everything in their world — every outcome, every failure, every gap — with zero excuses and zero blame passed down or sideways. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0002 — No Bad Teams, Only Bad Leaders (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: A team's performance is a direct reflection of its leader's standards, attitude, and example — a struggling team is a leadership problem before it's a personnel problem. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0003 — Believe (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: People will not fully commit to a mission until they understand and believe in the reason behind it — a leader must know the 'why' deeply enough to convince others of it. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0004 — Check the Ego (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: Ego clouds judgment, blinds a leader to real conditions, and prevents honest self-assessment — humility and objectivity have to win out over pride for good decisions to follow. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0005 — Cover and Move (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: Teams win through mutual support, not solo heroics — every part of the team is responsible for the success of every other part, because they all fail or succeed together. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0006 — Simple (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: Plans and instructions have to be stripped down to what's essential and easily understood — complexity breeds confusion, and confusion breeds failure under pressure. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0007 — Prioritize and Execute (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: When multiple problems hit at once, a leader has to relentlessly identify the single highest priority, solve that first, then move to the next — not try to fix everything simultaneously. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.
